# ExamplePlugin

A PocketMine-MP plugin built with the Pockgin standard workflow.

## How It Works

- On every push/PR, the plugin is validated and built using `@pockgin/cli`.
- When `plugin.yml` version is bumped and pushed to `main`, a GitHub Release is created automatically.
- The generated `.phar` file is attached to the release.

## Repository

See the source code at [pockgin/plugin-template](https://github.com/pockgin/plugin-template).
